resources.string: Choose a home-screen widget to edit its watchlist, groups, text size, layout, colors or refresh interval. Each widget keeps its own settings.
No stock widgets are installed. Add SilentPulse Stocks to your home screen to configure a watchlist.
To add a widget, long-press an empty area of your home screen, open Widgets, and choose SilentPulse Stocks. Your launcher controls widget placement and size.
Not configured — tap to set up a watchlist.
That stock widget is no longer available. Choose another widget or add SilentPulse Stocks from your home screen.
A last-used watchlist and its groups are saved on this device. They will pre-fill the next stock widget you add.

Settings backup saves stock watchlists, groups, appearance, refresh intervals, the remembered watchlist and imported presets.\n\nImporting keeps existing widgets unchanged. To use a restored watchlist, open a widget above (or add one), choose “Imported presets” from its menu, then review and Verify and save. New or unverified tickers require an online check before saving.
